source_grounding_result: The channel ranks already-admitted cache_v3.source_snapshot chunks. Fusion is retrieval._fuse_rankings(state.chunks, state.rankings + (("semantic", ranking),)) with RRF_K=60. Baseline is _retrieve_sources_with_state(..., influence="off") and equals retrieve_sources(..., influence="off"). Chunks are re-embedded when content SHA-256 changes.
privacy_result: security.scan_text runs on the query before any provider embed. Findings raise SemanticShadowError(query_privacy_refused, query) without echoing the value. Provider errors are re-raised with the provider reason only. Comparison documents carry query_digest and content_digest, not query or chunk text. Owned files are scan_bytes-clean.
retrieval_quality_result: R14 ranking is cosine with ascending summation, strict positive floor, top 64, (-similarity, pointer) ties, and truncated = candidate_count > 64. Abstention suppresses the semantic channel and skips embed. The channel is evidence-only: comparison authority fields are false and retrieval.py is unchanged.
compatibility_result: Adds palimnex.semantic_shadow (R14 constants, SemanticShadowError, SemanticChannel, EmbeddingMemo, semantic_channel, semantic_shadow_retrieve, validate_semantic_comparison, policy_digest) and palimnex:semantic-shadow-comparison:v1. palimnex/retrieval.py and palimnex/semantic.py have empty git diffs. Existing semantic and retrieval tests passed.
rollback_result: Delete palimnex/semantic_shadow.py, palimnex/tests/test_semantic_shadow.py, palimnex/schemas/semantic-shadow-comparison.v1.schema.json and the workstream implementation receipt. No production retrieval or wire identifier changes to revert.
